## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 2D MMORPG-style browser game.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (viewport ≤1280px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Use a self-contained HTML canvas game named “Emberfall — The Shattered Vale,” with a forest-glade setting, questing, combat, NPC interaction, and responsive touch controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Drafted the game’s visual interface and HTML/CSS in `index.html`.
- Drafted world rendering and core gameplay logic in `/tmp/opencode/core.js`.

### Active
- Integrate the gameplay script into `index.html`, finish the remaining game interactions, and verify the game in a browser.

### Blocked
- Current `index.html` ends at an open `<script>` tag; `/tmp/opencode/core.js` is also incomplete and has not been integrated.
- No screenshot or browser verification has been performed.

## Next Move
1. Continue implementing remaining JavaScript, including dialogue/modal handling, input bindings, and game startup.
2. Append the completed script to `index.html` and close the HTML document.
3. Run a JavaScript syntax check, launch the game, and inspect a current screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Current incomplete page with game UI and CSS; script body is missing.
- `/tmp/opencode/core.js`: Partial world rendering and game logic draft.
- `/tmp/opencode/game-tail.js`: Earlier partial dialogue/modal/input code, copied from an intermediate version; inspect before reuse.

## Important Context
- The game concept and UI include keyboard/touch movement, wildling combat, a quest to defeat three wildlings, Elder Rowan dialogue, inventory, character, map, and settings panels.
- Changes are uncommitted.
